property_summary: For any caller with sufficient balance, the caller's balance recorded by the contract must be reduced by exactly the withdrawn amount before any code of the recipient runs, so a re-entrant recipient observes the already-updated balance; the mutant writes the balance only after the external call, letting a re-entrant recipient observe the stale pre-withdrawal balance.
change_summary: Moves the balance update from before the external call to after it, preserving the same subtraction but changing when the state is written.
